name: ICICI Bank Ltd
title: ICICI Bank Ltd - 532174 - Transcript Of The Call With Media And Of Earnings Call With Analysts And Investors

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 PBT ex-treasury up 10.1% to ₹18,209 crore on provisions of just ₹96 crore (0.03% of advances), but guidance is only "range-bound" NIMs and no loan or deposit growth numbers; the provision drop is partly one-off recoveries.

triggers.label: NIM range-bound in FY27
triggers.quote: We do expect NIMs to be range-bound in FY27.

triggers.label: Q4 provisions ₹96 crore
triggers.quote: The total provisions during this quarter have been less than ₹100 crore, compared to ₹891 crore in the previous quarter.

guidance.quote: We do expect NIMs to be range-bound in FY27.
we would want to have opex growth at a level which is below the top line growth.

red_flags.label: Provisions fell 89-90% YoY to ₹96 crore, partly from one-off recoveries from written-off accounts
red_flags.quote: we have seen some improvement in quality of the portfolio and also certain corporate recoveries which have come from written-off accounts.

red_flags.label: Management declined to give co-lending NPA split or gold loan book size
red_flags.quote: We do not give state level data, Benn.

evasions.quote: I do not think so we give co-lending NPA ratio separately.
It is too early to call out on this.
We wouldn't get into giving a growth number.
